These operator graphs contain no learned weights. They express standard MatMul, masked Softmax and LogSoftmax operations for SHERLOQ. XFeat and LighterGlue/LightGlue retain their original authors and separately pinned model resources. The CPU FMA anchors are built using Emscripten and its musl/LLVM support; license texts are included. The Original-phase source-domain padding and intra-image identity policy are explicit SHERLOQ caller adaptations. No two-image authors parity or other LightGlue checkpoint qualification is implied.
